reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request introduces an excellent new feature: a web UI dashboard for monitoring the Jasper bot. The implementation is well-structured, with a clear separation between the Fastify backend and the static frontend. The dashboard provides valuable real-time insights into worker status, queues, cache, and logs.

My review includes a few points for improvement, mainly focusing on a potential security vulnerability (XSS) in the frontend and some minor cleanup. Addressing these will make the feature more robust and secure. Great work on this significant addition!
